terbaru.judul: Supply Chain Propagation of Textual Signals: LLM Embeddings and Cross-Sectional Return Predictability
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes a novel asset pricing framework that augments large language model (LLM) embeddings of annual report disclosures with supply chain knowledge graph (KG) propagation.

terbaru.judul: Group Quantization and Mellin Representations of the Heston Model
terbaru.pelajaran: We develop an Affine Holonomy Group Quantization framework for the Heston stochastic volatility model.

This paper has used European put option to construct the p-index risk measure to evaluate the performance of different investment strategies in China's SSE 50 index and the US SP500 index during 2018-2023.

terbaru.judul: ReSGA: A Large Tail Risk Model for Learning Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this limitation, we propose a large tail risk model, the retrieval-enhanced self-grouping autoencoder (ReSGA), which is designed with millions of parameters to exploit the rich cross-sectional dependence and long-term temporal dynamics of assets using their characteristics.

terbaru.judul: Continuous Timing Signals for Growth-Defensive Style Allocation: Factor Attribution, Risk Matching, and Out-of-Sample Evidence
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper studies conditional allocation between a growth/technology ETF basket, denoted by $G$, and a defensive income/value-oriented ETF basket, denoted by $D$.

terbaru.judul: Structural Limits of OHLCV-Based Intraday Momentum Signals in MNQ Futures: A Systematic Falsification Study
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper tests whether common intraday momentum signals built from OHLCV data generate a tradable edge in Micro E-Mini Nasdaq 100 (MNQ) futures after realistic execution costs.

terbaru.judul: Machine Learning Forecasts of Asymmetric Betas Using Firm-Specific Information
terbaru.pelajaran: We demonstrate that machine learning methods provide a powerful framework for modelling conditional asymmetric risk.

terbaru.judul: Dynamics of Periodic Bubbles and Crashes: Modeling Market Overheating and Panic Selling via Cubic Momentum
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes a simple and parsimonious discrete-time simulation model to describe the endogenous formation and periodic collapse of financial bubbles.

terbaru.judul: Signal or Noise in Multi-Agent LLM-based Stock Recommendations?
terbaru.pelajaran: We present the first portfolio-level validation of MarketSenseAI, a deployed multi-agent LLM equity system.

terbaru.judul: Hyper-Adaptive Momentum Dynamics for Native Cubic Portfolio Optimization: Avoiding Quadratization Distortion in Higher-Order Cardinality-Constrained Search
terbaru.pelajaran: We study cubic cardinality-constrained portfolio optimization, a higher-order extension of the standard Markowitz formulation where three-way sector co-movement terms augment the quadratic risk-return objective.
